qs.s: The council has painted a new pedestrian crossing outside the primary school. Since then, fewer children have been hurt, and parents feel more confident about the morning walk. What does "pedestrian crossing" mean?
o: vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ
qs.a: vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ
qs.vi: Hội đồng đã sơn vạch sang đường mới trước trường tiểu học. Từ đó ít trẻ bị thương hơn và phụ huynh yên tâm hơn khi đưa con đi bộ buổi sáng.
qs.why: pedestrian crossing = vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ (Anh-Anh); Anh-Mỹ: crosswalk.
qs.say: The council has painted a new pedestrian crossing outside the primary school. Since then, fewer children have been hurt, and parents feel more confident about the morning walk.

qs.s: An American friend told me to use the crosswalk instead of running across the busy street. She said it is not only safer but also required by law. What does "crosswalk" mean?
o: vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ
qs.a: vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ
qs.vi: Một người bạn Mỹ bảo tôi dùng vạch sang đường thay vì chạy qua con phố đông. Cô nói như vậy không chỉ an toàn hơn mà còn bắt buộc theo luật.
qs.why: crosswalk = vạch sang đường cho người đi bộ (Anh-Mỹ); Anh-Anh: pedestrian crossing.
qs.say: An American friend told me to use the crosswalk instead of running across the busy street. She said it is not only safer but also required by law.

qs.s: Crossing the road in this city can be difficult because motorbikes come from every direction. Locals advise tourists to walk slowly and steadily so that drivers can avoid them. What does "crossing the road" mean?
qs.vi: Sang đường ở thành phố này có thể khó vì xe máy đến từ mọi hướng. Người địa phương khuyên du khách đi chậm và đều để tài xế tránh được.
qs.why: crossing the road = sang đường, băng qua đường; cross the road.
qs.say: Crossing the road in this city can be difficult because motorbikes come from every direction. Locals advise tourists to walk slowly and steadily so that drivers can avoid them.

qs.s: A new road sign has been put up near the school to remind drivers to slow down. It shows two children crossing, and it flashes when a car goes too fast. What does "road sign" mean?
qs.vi: Một biển báo giao thông mới được dựng gần trường để nhắc tài xế giảm tốc. Biển hình hai đứa trẻ băng qua và nhấp nháy khi xe đi quá nhanh.
qs.why: road sign = biển báo giao thông; traffic sign cũng dùng.
qs.say: A new road sign has been put up near the school to remind drivers to slow down. It shows two children crossing, and it flashes when a car goes too fast.

qs.s: A sign saying no overtaking appears every few hundred metres on this hill road. Because the view ahead is limited, passing another car there could cause a head-on crash. What does "no overtaking" mean?
qs.vi: Biển cấm vượt xuất hiện cứ vài trăm mét trên đường đồi này. Vì tầm nhìn phía trước hạn chế, vượt xe ở đó có thể gây va chạm trực diện.
qs.why: no overtaking = cấm vượt (biển báo hoặc quy định); overtake = vượt xe khác.
qs.say: A sign saying no overtaking appears every few hundred metres on this hill road. Because the view ahead is limited, passing another car there could cause a head-on crash.

qs.s: On the motorway, a red sports car overtook us at great speed and disappeared round the corner within seconds. Dad said such drivers should be careful. What does "overtook" mean?
qs.vi: Trên đường cao tốc, một chiếc xe thể thao đỏ vượt chúng tôi với tốc độ rất cao và biến mất sau góc cua trong vài giây. Bố nói những tài xế như vậy nên cẩn thận.
qs.why: overtake sth/sb = vượt (xe khác); quá khứ overtook; quá khứ phân từ overtaken.
qs.say: On the motorway, a red sports car overtook us at great speed and disappeared round the corner within seconds. Dad said such drivers should be careful.

qs.s: After several accidents, the council lowered the speed limit near the school from fifty to thirty. Drivers who break the rule are caught by cameras at the roadside. What does "speed limit" mean?
qs.vi: Sau vài vụ tai nạn, hội đồng hạ giới hạn tốc độ gần trường từ năm mươi xuống ba mươi. Tài xế vi phạm bị camera ven đường ghi lại.
qs.why: speed limit = giới hạn tốc độ (tốc độ tối đa cho phép).
qs.say: After several accidents, the council lowered the speed limit near the school from fifty to thirty. Drivers who break the rule are caught by cameras at the roadside.

qs.s: A new motorway will connect the port to the capital, cutting the journey from five hours to three. Local businesses hope it will bring more customers and cheaper deliveries. What does "motorway" mean?
qs.vi: Một đường cao tốc mới sẽ nối cảng với thủ đô, rút chuyến đi từ năm xuống ba tiếng. Doanh nghiệp địa phương hy vọng nó đem thêm khách và giao hàng rẻ hơn.
qs.why: motorway = đường cao tốc (Anh-Anh); Anh-Mỹ: highway/freeway.
qs.say: A new motorway will connect the port to the capital, cutting the journey from five hours to three. Local businesses hope it will bring more customers and cheaper deliveries.

qs.s: My grandmother always stays in the inside lane on the motorway because she drives at about sixty. Faster cars use the other lane, so they pass her without any problem. What does "inside lane" mean?
qs.vi: Bà tôi luôn đi làn trong trên đường cao tốc vì bà lái khoảng sáu mươi. Xe nhanh hơn dùng làn kia nên vượt bà không vấn đề gì.
qs.why: inside lane = làn gần lề/làn chậm trên đường cao tốc (Anh); outside lane = làn nhanh.
qs.say: My grandmother always stays in the inside lane on the motorway because she drives at about sixty. Faster cars use the other lane, so they pass her without any problem.

qs.s: Racing drivers love the outside lane, where they can accelerate and pass slower cars. However, ordinary drivers should return to the inside lane after overtaking. What does "outside lane" mean?
o: làn dành cho người đi bộ
qs.vi: Tay đua yêu làn ngoài, nơi họ tăng tốc và vượt xe chậm hơn. Tuy nhiên tài xế bình thường nên trở lại làn trong sau khi vượt.
qs.why: outside lane = làn xa lề/làn nhanh để vượt trên đường cao tốc (Anh); inside lane = làn chậm.
qs.say: Racing drivers love the outside lane, where they can accelerate and pass slower cars. However, ordinary drivers should return to the inside lane after overtaking.

sections.title: Nói vận dụng
sections.note: Bấm ghi âm và trả lời bằng tiếng Anh, cố dùng các từ gợi ý; trang sẽ chấm ước tính 4 tiêu chí.

qs.s: Describe the place where you live or would like to live. Say what the main rooms are like and how you got it.
qs.vi: Hãy tả nơi bạn sống hoặc muốn sống. Nói các phòng chính như thế nào và bạn có nơi đó bằng cách nào.
qs.why: Nêu loại nhà, phòng bạn thích, đồ nội thất; so sánh thuê dài hạn (rent) và thuê ngắn hạn (hire); dùng although/instead of.
qs.sample: I would like to describe my ideal flat. Last year I decided to rent a small place near my office instead of buying one, because I wanted flexibility. The living room is a carpeted room with large windows, and in the corner there is a firm armchair where I read in the evenings. The only problem is the parking space: there are very few, so I hire a car only when I travel at weekends. Although the flat is not luxurious, it is comfortable and quiet, and I feel at home there.

qs.s: Talk about a time when you bought something expensive. Was it worth the price? Explain why or why not.
qs.vi: Hãy kể về một lần bạn mua món đồ đắt tiền. Nó có đáng giá không? Giải thích vì sao.
words: earn a reasonable amount of money
qs.why: Kể món đồ, giá, so sánh với món khác; dùng good/poor value for money và lý do; thêm whereas/although.
qs.sample: Last year I bought a laptop for my studies. Many shops charge customers a lot for famous brands, so I compared prices for a week. I do not earn a reasonable amount of money yet, only a small part-time salary, so I could not spend a potload of money. Finally I chose a mid-priced model, which I think was good value for money, whereas a friend's tablet was poor value for money because it broke after six months. Next time I will ask whether the shop will charge me for repairs, because some stores charge customers for services that should be free.

qs.s: Why do some people choose a job because they love it rather than because of the salary? What do you think?
qs.vi: Vì sao một số người chọn công việc vì yêu thích hơn là vì lương? Bạn nghĩ sao?
qs.why: Nêu quan điểm, lấy ví dụ người thân bỏ lương cao theo đam mê; dùng essentially, a sense of achievement, nhượng bộ bằng although.
qs.sample: Hold on a second, let me think. Essentially, I believe people are happier when they have a passion for their work. Many of us assume that a high salary is essential, but I think a sense of achievement matters more. For example, my aunt left a well-paid position at a bank to teach children, and she says that contributing to the betterment of her community gives her more satisfaction than money ever did. Of course, we all need enough income to live, although it should not be the only goal.

qs.s: Which invention do you think has changed people's lives the most? Explain your choice.
qs.vi: Theo bạn phát minh nào đã thay đổi cuộc sống con người nhiều nhất? Giải thích lựa chọn của bạn.
qs.why: Chọn một phát minh, nói nó thay đổi lĩnh vực nào, nêu ví dụ và mặt trái; dùng revolutionize, revolution, humanity.
qs.sample: I think the smartphone has changed life more than any other invention. It was a revolutionary device because it combined a phone, a camera and a computer in one pocket. In just ten years it started to revolutionize education, banking and entertainment, and many experts describe the change as a digital revolution. Although it causes problems such as addiction, I believe it has helped humanity by giving people instant access to information. For instance, students in remote villages can now watch lessons online, which would have been impossible a generation ago.

qs.s: Describe a sports person you admire. Say what they have achieved and why you respect them.
qs.vi: Hãy tả một người chơi thể thao bạn ngưỡng mộ. Nói họ đạt được gì và vì sao bạn kính trọng họ.
qs.why: Giới thiệu người đó, thành tích, quá trình luyện tập, lý do ngưỡng mộ; dùng thì quá khứ và which.
qs.sample: I admire a swimmer from my country who is a real record breaker. She trained like a professional athlete from the age of ten, getting up before dawn every day. At the age of twenty she managed to break a record that nobody had beaten for fifteen years. My father, who used to be a keen sportsman himself, says her discipline is what impresses him most. I respect her because she never gave up, even after a serious injury, and she now encourages younger girls to take up sport.

qs.s: Do you enjoy cooking? Tell me about a dish you like to prepare or eat.
qs.vi: Bạn có thích nấu ăn không? Hãy kể về một món bạn thích nấu hoặc ăn.
qs.why: Nói mức nấu ăn của bạn, món yêu thích, nguyên liệu, cách tự sáng tạo; dùng although, which, otherwise.
qs.sample: I enjoy cooking, although I am not good at cooking complicated dishes yet. My favourite meal is a seafood pasta with mussels and scallops, which I first tried at a restaurant near the sea. When I got home, I came up with my own version, using garlic, lemon and a little cream. The scallops must be cooked very quickly, otherwise they become tough, while the mussels need only a few minutes in hot wine. My friends say it tastes better than the restaurant's version, which makes me feel proud.

qs.s: Would you prefer to live in a big city or in a small town? Give reasons for your answer.
qs.vi: Bạn thích sống ở thành phố lớn hay thị trấn nhỏ? Nêu lý do.
words: be just around the corner from
qs.why: Chọn một bên, nêu 2-3 lý do (hoạt động, giao thông, an ninh), so sánh bằng whereas; dùng các cụm around the corner.
qs.sample: I would prefer a big city, mainly because there is always something going on. Cultural activities such as concerts and exhibitions are everywhere, and the nightlife is lively. My flat would be just around the corner from the metro, so travelling would not be stressful, whereas in the countryside I would feel stressed by long journeys. A city is also a mix of different people and ideas. Of course, the crime rate is usually higher, but I would choose a safe district. Besides, the weekend is just around the corner, and there is a café around the corner where I could meet friends.

qs.s: Describe your journey to work or school. How do you travel, and what problems do you have on the way?
qs.vi: Hãy tả hành trình đến chỗ làm hoặc trường học. Bạn đi bằng gì và gặp vấn đề gì trên đường?
qs.why: Nêu phương tiện, thời gian, khó khăn (đợi xe, sang đường); dùng so, because, sometimes để nối ý.
qs.sample: I usually get the bus to university because there is no parking space near my building. I wait at the stop for ten minutes, and sometimes two buses come along together. The journey stretches over forty minutes, so I listen to podcasts. Before reaching the stop I use the pedestrian crossing, which Americans call a crosswalk. Crossing the road in my city can be dangerous in the rush hour because motorbikes rarely stop, so I always wait for the green light and walk carefully with other people.

qs.s: Tell me about a place in the countryside that you know. What do people do there, and what is life like?
qs.vi: Hãy kể về một nơi ở nông thôn mà bạn biết. Người ta làm gì ở đó và cuộc sống ra sao?
qs.why: Tả cảnh, nghề nghiệp, một ngày của người nông dân; dùng although để nói mặt tốt và mặt khó.
qs.sample: My grandparents live in a village in the north, where the scenery is beautiful, with green hills and a clear river. My uncle owns a farm there. He keeps animals such as cows and chickens, and he grows crops like rice, corn and even a little barley. Rice is the main crop, and farming is hard work, so he is up at five every morning. Although life is simple, I envy him a little, because the air is clean and the neighbours are friendly. One day I would like to live in a village like that.

qs.s: What advice would you give to a new driver? Talk about the most important rules on the road.
qs.vi: Bạn sẽ khuyên người mới lái xe điều gì? Hãy nói về các quy tắc quan trọng nhất.
qs.why: Đưa 3-4 lời khuyên có lý do (tốc độ, giao lộ, biển báo, làn đường), dùng if/because/until để triển khai.
qs.sample: My main advice to a new driver is to respect the speed limit at all times. When you reach a junction, slow down and look carefully. If there is a bend ahead, remember that the road may bend sharply, so stay in control. Always read every road sign, especially no overtaking signs near hills. On the motorway, stay in the inside lane until you feel confident, then use the outside lane only when you need to overtake. Most accidents happen because people hurry, so patience is the best rule of all.
